AH32.note:
As a Double Action, you can make a CMA against an adjacent opponent's CMD to attempt to grab onto an opponent. If you succeed, both you and the target gain the Grappled Condition. As a Double Action on a following turn, you can attempt to maintain the condition. Maintaining Grapple is a CMA Check with a +5 bonus against your opponent’s CMD. If you succeed, you can apply one of the following effects:
Drag: You can move both you and your opponent up to half your Movement Speed.
Pummel: Deal damage as if you hit with an Unarmed Melee Attack or One-Handed Melee Weapon.
Pin: The target gains the Pinned Condition.
Bind: If the target is Pinned, you can tie them up (if you have the materials to do so).
Your opponent can attempt to break out of your grip with a Double Action using their CMA or Acrobatics/Athletics against your CMD.You cannot Grapple an opponent of a higher Size Category than yourself. Using Grapple provokes an Attack of Opportunity.

DROP PRONE [Move]
You fall prone.

Prone renders you flat-footed (-2 AC) and inflicts a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls.

Suggestion
Double Action
V, M
30 ft
Concentration, up to 8 hours

You can target 1 creature within range, suggest a course of activity (in a sentence or so) and force them to make a Will Save. If they fail, and the activity is reasonable, they pursue the course of action suggested until the task is completed or the spell ends. If the target is damaged or obviously threatened by you or an ally the spell ends.

AB44.note:
Double Action*
V, S, M
60 ft Line
Concentration, up to 1 minute

You create a strong gust of wind that is 60 feet long and 10 feet wide originating from you. Movement towards you in the wind is considered Difficult Terrain, while movement away from you is doubled. This wind disperses any gasses, smokes, vapors or fires. You can change the direction of the line as a Single Action.
Any creature that starts their turn in the line must make a Fortitude save or be pushed back 15 feet and take 2d6 points of Force Damage. Huge and larger creatures are immune to the effects of this spell.

AI44.note:

Double Action
V, S, M
Touch
1 hour

A creature you Touch gains DR 10 for the duration. This DR can only absorb damage equal to 10 per level of the caster. Once it has absorbed the maximum amount of damage, the spell is discharged early. You can only have 1 instance of this spell active at a time.

To cast this spell on a creature more than once per day, the spell consumes 100 gold worth of diamond dust on each subsequent casting.

AP44.note:
Doesn't use a spell slot
Double Action
120 ft
V, S
10 minutes, Concentration

When you cast the spell, and as a Single Action on each following turn for the duration, you can exert your will on one creature or object within range, applying the appropriate effect below. If you switch the target of this spell, the previous target is no longer affected by the spell.
Creature: You can try to move a creature up to 2 Size Categories larger. You can make a Ranged Spell Attack on that creature against that creature's CMB Defense. If you succeed, you can move the creature up to 30 feet in any direction, including upwards, though you cannot move them outside of the range of this spell. Until the end of your next turn, that creature is magically Grappled and unable to break free while the effects are active. On subsequent rounds, you can maintain the grip by repeating the contest as your Following Single Action.
Object: You can move an object that weights up to 1000 pounds. If they object isn’t being worn or carried, you can automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction, but not beyond the range of this spell. If the object is worn or carried, you can make a Ranged Spell Attack on that creature against that creature's CMB Defense, and if you succeed, you pull the item away from that creature and up to 30 feet in any direction, but not beyond the range of this spell. You have complete control of the object while under your control, even making fine and minute maneuvers.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the number of creatures and/or objects you can have under your effect increases by for each Spell Slot higher than normal. While objects will stay in the air, creatures will not be affected following any turn you don't maintain the grip as normal.

S
30
Instantaneous or up to 1 hour

You can create up to 2 Gallons of Water. This water cannot be created within a creature's open mouth or similar areas. Any water not consumed or used within 24 hours disappears. You can also control the state of water, either freezing or unfreezing a 5 foot cube or turning it into mist or back in a 5 foot cube. 
You can also control the color, opacity, flow, or create forms in the water that are animated and controlled by you for up to an hour.

V, S, M
60 ft
1 Hour

You create an invisible servant of medium size. It cannot attack nor take damage. You can mentally control it once per turn to move up to 15 feet and manipulate an object. If the servant leaves 60 feet of you it disspells. It can only exert 20 pounds of force and can only lift up to 20 pounds or push 100. It is treated as having rolled a 10 on any skill check it is required to make.

U45.note:
Silence
Double Action
V, S
Touch/ 120 ft
Concentration, up to 10 minutes

This spell causes an object or a point within range, or that you are touching, to completely mute sound within a 20-foot-radius sphere around that item or point. While in the area, creatures are immune to Sonic Damage and are Deafened. Spells that require a Verbal Component (V) cannot be cast while in that area. If you cast this spell on an item attended by another creature, they can roll a Will Save to negate the effects of the spell.

V, S, M
100 ft Line
Instantaneous

You create a bolt of lightning that is 100 feet long and 5 feet wide originating from you in a direction of your choice. Each creature in the line must make a Reflex Save. On a failed roll, anyone within the line takes 8d6 + CHA points of Lightning Damage, or half on a Successful Save. The lightning ignites unattended flammable objects.

Upcast When this spell is cast in a higher level Spell Slot the damage is increased by 1d6 for each Spell Slot higher than normal.

AI45.note:
Double Action
V, S, M
60 ft
Instantaneous

You can target up to 5 enemies within your range, a line of fire streaks out towards those targets, exploding in a column of fire. Each target must make a Reflex Save or take 8d6 + INT points of Fire Damage. On a Successful Save, they only take half as much damage.

You can instead have all the threads converge on a single target, instead dealing 12d6 + INT Fire Damage on a Failed Reflex Save, or half as much on a success.

The fire travels over obstacles up to 5 feet high, and ignites anything unattended and flammable along the path.

Upcast When this spell is cast in a higher level Spell Slot the damage is increased by 1d6 for each Spell Slot higher than normal.

AB46.note:
Counter and Dispel Magic
Double Action or Reaction
S
60 ft
Instantaneous
When you cast this spell you may either cast it as a Double Action or a Reaction and Apply the appropriate effect.

As a Double Action, You can target 1 specific magic effect currently active within 120 feet. If the spell is 3 or Lower, you automatically dispel it and it has no effect. If the spell is 4 or higher, you must roll an INT check equal or higher to 10 + Level of spell to dispel it.

As a Reaction, you can attempt to counter an enemies spell or spell-like ability within 60 that you can see. If the spell is 3 or Lower, you automatically counter the spell and it has no effect. If the spell is 4 or higher, you must roll an INT check equal or higher to 10 + Level of spell to dispel it.

Upcast When this spell is cast in a higher level Spell Slot, the level of spell you automatically can counter or dispel increases for each Spell Slot higher than normal.

Double Action
V
60 ft
1 Round

You can target 1 creature you can see within range and give them a one word command. They must make a Will Save or comply. You can issue a command from the following list, or come up with a word of your own, but the DM decides what happens in such a case.

Approach: The target moves as close to you as possible before ending their turn.
Drop: The Target drops whatever it is holding and ends its turn.
Flee: The Target spends its turn fleeing you as fast as possible.
Down: The target drops prone and ends its turn.

In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

M28.formattedValue:

- Save Spells: If the spell normally requires one Save and no Attack Roll, you may instead deliver it through the Melee Attack. On a hit, the target suffers the spell’s full effect; on a miss, they take no effect (ignoring the spell’s usual partial-on-save outcome).

M51.formattedValue: INVESTMENT: As a Single Action, You may take a penalty to an Ability Score of 2 to grant a +4 to that same Ability Score to an ally you can see. This lasts for up to 1 hour per level, or until you end the effects as a Single Action on your Turn. When you end an investment, your affected ability score is increased by 4 for as long as you had invested for. You cannot reinvest a stat while it is increased by this effect. You may only have a number of investments equal to your CHA modifier and they must be of different Ability Scores.
